cast.bio: Former MIT gravitational theorist recruited to decrypt anomaly pulses near Titan.
Decorated sub-orbital pilot dealing with the loss of the Helios IV crew.
Sentient navigational matrix trained on 140 petabytes of deep space radio signatures.

timecode_events.title: Elena decrypts the Harmonic Beacon
timecode_events.summary: Dr. Elena Vance isolates a 4.2Hz resonant wave that matches pre-collapse quantum transmitters.
timecode_events.significance: Crucial Plot Turning Point: Elena discovers the signal was transmitted from inside the anomaly, not outside.
timecode_events.trivia: The sound frequency used in this sequence was synthesized from actual Voyager 1 interstellar plasma wave recordings.
suggested_questions: Why does Elena recognize the frequency?
What happened to the previous mission Helios IV?

timecode_events.title: Commander Marcus Reed Enters Bridge
timecode_events.summary: Marcus confronts Elena regarding fuel reserves before orbital insertion.
timecode_events.significance: Character Tension: Marcus fears repeating the Helios IV disaster where his copilot was stranded.
timecode_events.trivia: Actor David Sterling trained for 3 weeks in a neutral buoyancy centrifuge for zero-G posture realism.
suggested_questions: What is the current ship status?

timecode_events.title: Quantum Singularity Proximity Alert
timecode_events.summary: A.R.I.A. detects relativistic time dilation accelerating at 1.8x baseline Earth standard.
timecode_events.significance: Time Dilation Threat: Every minute spent in orbit equals 3 months in Earth time.
timecode_events.trivia: The visual effects team consulted with Caltech gravitational physicists to render the gravitational lensing distortion.
suggested_questions: How much time is passing on Earth?
Can the engine handle the tidal forces?
